notes.text: TRIAGED (source review 2026-08-09, confidence medium): MSUI draws overhead unit names with the core of Benilla's law, and cites it: the height-scale formula (d>4 ? d/4*1.5*0.2 : 0.2) projected as a true world pitch so distance shrinks names, reaction coloring shared with the selection-ring palette, the show gates (own name on, dead creatures only via the target rescue, players/NPCs on), plus the separate enemy V-plate layer whose last-frame rects feed the shared hover/selection pick. Several byte-verified aspects of the reference presentation are missing.
